title: Money
description: What came in, what went out, and the fixed costs form.

panels.title: Customers paid
panels.description: What customers paid in the time range, tax included, minus refunds. Real purchases only.

targets.rawSql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, CASE store WHEN 'PLAY_STORE' THEN 'Google Play' WHEN 'APP_STORE' THEN 'App Store' WHEN 'STRIPE' THEN 'Stripe' ELSE initcap(store) END AS store, price_usd AS paid,
         price_usd * coalesce(tax_percentage, 0) AS tax,
         price_usd * (1 - coalesce(tax_percentage, 0) - coalesce(commission_percentage, 0)) AS take_home
  FROM stats.billing_events
  WHERE environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND (type IN ('INITIAL_PURCHASE', 'RENEWAL', 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE') OR (type = 'CANCELLATION' AND price_usd < 0)) AND price_usd IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
) SELECT coalesce(sum(paid), 0) AS "Customers paid" FROM revenue

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: Costs
panels.description: Every cost in the time range: your fixed costs, Claude, the stores' commission and Stripe's fees.

targets.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT d::date AS day FROM generate_series(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date, interval '1 day') AS d
),
costs AS (
  SELECT d.day, CASE c.category WHEN 'app_stores' THEN 'App stores' ELSE initcap(c.category) END AS category,
         CASE c.period
           WHEN 'once' THEN c.amount_usd
           WHEN 'yearly' THEN c.amount_usd / 12 / extract(day FROM date_trunc('month', d.day) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')
           ELSE c.amount_usd / extract(day FROM date_trunc('month', d.day) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')
         END AS usd
  FROM days d
  JOIN stats.costs c ON d.day >= c.starts_on AND d.day <= coalesce(c.ends_on, d.day) AND (c.period <> 'once' OR d.day = c.starts_on)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 'Claude', cost_usd
  FROM stats.question_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, CASE store WHEN 'PLAY_STORE' THEN 'Google Play' WHEN 'APP_STORE' THEN 'App Store' WHEN 'STRIPE' THEN 'Stripe' ELSE initcap(store) END, price_usd * coalesce(commission_percentage, 0)
  FROM stats.billing_events
  WHERE environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND (type IN ('INITIAL_PURCHASE', 'RENEWAL', 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE') OR (type = 'CANCELLATION' AND price_usd < 0)) AND coalesce(store, '') <> 'STRIPE' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 'Stripe', fee
  FROM stats.stripe_fees WHERE environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
) SELECT coalesce(sum(usd), 0) AS "Costs" FROM costs

panels.title: Paying now
panels.description: Accounts with a bought premium that hasn't run out.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Paying now" FROM stats.users WHERE plan = 'premium'

panels.title: Trial to paid
panels.description: Of the trials that ended in the time range, the share that bought premium.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM stats.billing_events b
         WHERE b.user_id = u.id AND b.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND b.type IN ('INITIAL_PURCHASE', 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE')))
       / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Trial to paid"
FROM stats.users u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.trial_ends_at) AND u.trial_ends_at <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

panels.title: Cancellations
panels.description: Subscriptions turned off in the time range. They keep premium until the end of what they paid for.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Cancellations" FROM stats.billing_events
WHERE environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND type = 'CANCELLATION' AND coalesce(price_usd, 0) >= 0 AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Refunds
panels.description: Refunds in the time range, and how much went back.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Refunds", coalesce(-sum(price_usd), 0) AS "Refunded" FROM stats.billing_events
WHERE environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND type = 'CANCELLATION' AND price_usd < 0 AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

targets.rawSql:
WITH revenue AS (

),
costs AS (
  SELECT d.day, CASE c.category WHEN 'app_stores' THEN 'App stores' ELSE initcap(c.category) END AS category,
         CASE c.period
           WHEN 'once' THEN c.amount_usd
           WHEN 'yearly' THEN c.amount_usd / 12 / extract(day FROM date_trunc('month', d.day) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')
           ELSE c.amount_usd / extract(day FROM date_trunc('month', d.day) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')
         END AS usd
  FROM days d
  JOIN stats.costs c ON d.day >= c.starts_on AND d.day <= coalesce(c.ends_on, d.day) AND (c.period <> 'once' OR d.day = c.starts_on)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 'Claude', cost_usd
  FROM stats.question_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, CASE store WHEN 'PLAY_STORE' THEN 'Google Play' WHEN 'APP_STORE' THEN 'App Store' WHEN 'STRIPE' THEN 'Stripe' ELSE initcap(store) END, price_usd * coalesce(commission_percentage, 0)
  FROM stats.billing_events
  WHERE environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND (type IN ('INITIAL_PURCHASE', 'RENEWAL', 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE') OR (type = 'CANCELLATION' AND price_usd < 0)) AND coalesce(store, '') <> 'STRIPE' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 'Stripe', fee

SELECT to_char(m.month, 'Mon YYYY') AS "Month",
       coalesce((SELECT sum(paid) FROM revenue r WHERE date_trunc('month', r.day)::date = m.month), 0) AS "Customers paid",
       coalesce((SELECT sum(usd) FROM costs c WHERE date_trunc('month', c.day)::date = m.month), 0) AS "Costs",

         - coalesce((SELECT sum(usd) FROM costs c WHERE date_trunc('month', c.day)::date = m.month), 0) AS "Profit"
FROM months m ORDER BY m.month

panels.description: What customers paid each month through each store, minus refunds.

targets.rawSql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, CASE store WHEN 'PLAY_STORE' THEN 'Google Play' WHEN 'APP_STORE' THEN 'App Store' WHEN 'STRIPE' THEN 'Stripe' ELSE initcap(store) END AS store, price_usd AS paid,
         price_usd * coalesce(tax_percentage, 0) AS tax,
         price_usd * (1 - coalesce(tax_percentage, 0) - coalesce(commission_percentage, 0)) AS take_home
  FROM stats.billing_events

panels.title: Top 10 accounts by Claude cost
panels.description: What each account's questions cost in Claude in the time range. Click an email for its detail in Users.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.id, u.email AS "Email", count(*) AS "Questions", sum(q.cost_usd) AS "Claude cost"
FROM stats.question_costs q JOIN stats.users u ON u.id = q.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.created_at)
GROUP BY u.id, u.email ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

panels.title: Fixed costs
panels.description: Click a cost's name to change its amount, end it or remove it. Refresh the dashboard after a change to see it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.id, c.name AS "Name", CASE c.category WHEN 'app_stores' THEN 'App stores' ELSE initcap(c.category) END AS "Category", c.amount_usd AS "Amount", initcap(c.period) AS "Every",
       c.starts_on::timestamptz AS "Starts", c.ends_on::timestamptz AS "Ends",
       CASE WHEN c.period = 'once' THEN 'Paid once'
            WHEN c.ends_on < current_date THEN 'Ended'
            WHEN c.ends_on IS NOT NULL THEN 'Ending'
            ELSE 'Running' END AS "Status",
       CASE c.period WHEN 'monthly' THEN c.amount_usd WHEN 'yearly' THEN c.amount_usd / 12 END AS "Per month"
FROM stats.costs c
ORDER BY (c.period <> 'once' AND (c.ends_on IS NULL OR c.ends_on >= current_date)) DESC, c.starts_on DESC

panels.title: Latest billing events
panels.description: Real purchases, renewals, cancellations and refunds in the time range, newest first, up to 100.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS "When", initcap(replace(b.type, '_', ' ')) AS "Event", CASE b.store WHEN 'PLAY_STORE' THEN 'Google Play' WHEN 'APP_STORE' THEN 'App Store' WHEN 'STRIPE' THEN 'Stripe' ELSE initcap(b.store) END AS "Store",
       b.product_id AS "Product", b.price_usd AS "Paid", initcap(replace(b.cancel_reason, '_', ' ')) AS "Reason",
       u.email AS "Email", b.user_id AS id
FROM stats.billing_events b LEFT JOIN stats.users u ON u.id = b.user_id
WHERE b.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND $__timeFilter(b.occurred_at)
ORDER BY b.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
